notes: Fix pass from a real phone test: text no longer doubles or ghosts on screen, and the same results no longer stack two and three times — after a session, the card under your results shows your PREVIOUS session, not the same one again.

Uploaded clips are analyzed as clips now: the banner says “Analyzing clip…” (no more “Recording… hold up 2 fingers”), and AI moments carry real timestamps from your video — tap one and the replay jumps to that second.

Steadier eyes: the activity label has to hold for a beat before it can change, and once your clip is a start or sprint, squat and deadlift labels can't sneak in — no more “one fix: hinge angle” in the middle of a block start.

One rep count everywhere: your summary, the deep check and your saved sessions all count from the same checked list, so they can't disagree — and short blips no longer turn into fake reps. Scores and angles are also kept in their real ranges (no more -50% or -174°).

Photo labels fixed — the big one: labels on your worst frame and AI Photo now sit in one neat column at the edge of the picture with lines pointing to each joint, so they never pile on top of each other or get cut off.
Your clip fills its frame: the preview now takes your video's own shape and the skeleton rides on you at full size, instead of a tiny figure lost in a black box.
